headline: LO:TECH Raises $12 Million to Expand Crypto Trading into U.S. and Asia
summary: LO:TECH raised $12 million in funding to expand its round-the-clock tokenized stock trading operations into the United States and Asia.
why: Venture capital funding rounds enable early-stage financial technology firms to scale infrastructure and enter regulated international markets.

impacts.why: The company raised capital to fund expansion.
